modern: Retire into yourself. The rational principle which rules has this nature: that it is content with itself when it does what is just, and so secures tranquillity.
original: Retire into thyself. The rational principle which rules has this nature, that it is content with itself when it does what is just, and so secures tranquillity.
notification: Retire into yourself. The rational principle which rules has this nature: that it is content with itself when it does what is just, and so secures tranquillity.
notification_original: Retire into thyself. The rational principle which rules has this nature, that it is content with itself when it does what is just, and so secures tranquillity.

explained.summary: Withdraw into yourself. Your reasoning mind has the happy quality of being content with itself whenever it acts justly, and that contentment is where peace of mind comes from. You don’t need outside approval to feel settled.
